description: Ines sends a message in the group chat about the shared birthday dinner, asking who will host.
Bea looks up her work schedule for the proposed birthday dinner date.
Bea sends a message in the group chat saying she can't host due to night shifts, but is happy to help with food or setup.
Ines notices Bea's message in the group chat.
Tomas picks up his phone and sees the group chat notification. He opens it and reads Bea's message.
Kwame's phone remains off or he does not check the group chat. The message sits unread on his phone.
